# peernode_storage_bucket (Resource)

A storage bucket. `s3` buckets (the default) are used with any S3 tool at `endpoint` (path-style, region `us-east-1`) with keys from `peernode_storage_access_key`; their names are global. `vault` buckets are end-to-end encrypted by the browser or the `peernode` CLI and have no S3 access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A private S3-compatible bucket (the default): use it with aws cli, rclone, restic or any S3 SDK.
resource "peernode_storage_bucket" "backups" {
  name = "acme-backups"
}

# A public bucket: anyone can download objects at public_url + key.
resource "peernode_storage_bucket" "assets" {
  name          = "acme-assets"
  visibility    = "public"
  node_count    = 3
  force_destroy = true # delete the objects with the bucket
}

# An end-to-end encrypted vault: files are encrypted in the browser or the peernode CLI; no S3 access.
resource "peernode_storage_bucket" "vault" {
  name = "acme-vault"
  kind = "vault"
}

output "assets_url" {
  value = peernode_storage_bucket.assets.public_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name: 3-63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

### Optional

- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Delete every object when the bucket is destroyed. Without it, destroying a bucket that has objects fails.
- `kind` (String) `s3` (default) or `vault`.
- `node_count` (Number) Storage nodes that hold each file; one of them may be lost. `s3`: 2-17 (default 2). `vault`: 1-17.
- `visibility` (String) `private` (default for `s3`: every request needs an access key) or `public` (anyone can download objects by URL; listing and uploads still need a key). Changed in place. Not used by `vault` buckets.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint (`s3` buckets).
- `id` (String) Bucket ID.
- `public_url` (String) URL prefix of the objects of a public `s3` bucket (empty otherwise).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Buckets are imported by name.
terraform import peernode_storage_bucket.backups acme-backups
```
